title: Pepper Glow
body_html:
Female Enhancement is a supplement crafted to help women feel their best every day. This formula includes key vitamins such as B6, B12, and Pantothenic Acid, which contribute to energy metabolism and overall vitality. Zinc is also included to support normal immune function and wellness.


This supplement features a unique blend of traditional herbal extracts, including Tribulus, Ashwagandha, and Ginseng, which have been used to promote balance and relaxation. Damiana and Dong Quai complement the formula, offering additional support for overall well-being. L-Arginine, an important amino acid, is also included to support normal circulation.


To enhance the value of this formula, BioPerine® Black Pepper Extract is added to support nutrient absorption. With a carefully selected combination of natural ingredients, Female Enhancement is designed to help women maintain energy, balance, and overall wellness as part of their daily routine.*



Ingredients: Vitamin A (as Beta-Carotene), Thiamin (as Thiamin Mononitrate), Niacin (as Niacin), Vitamin B6 (as Pyridoxine HCI), Vitamin B12 (as Cyanocobalamin), Pantothenic Acid (as D-Calcium Pantothenate), Zinc (as Zinc Oxide), L-Arginine (Base), BioPerine® (Black Pepper Extract) (Piper nigrum) (Fruit), Epimedium Powder (Epimedium sagittatum) (Aerial), Tribulus Extract (Tribulus terrestris L.) (Fruit), Catuaba Powder (Trichilia catigua) (Bark), Dong Quai (Angelica sinensis) (Root), Ginkgo (Ginkgo biloba) (Leaf), Asian Ginseng (Panax ginseng) (Root), Damiana Powder (Turnera diffusa) (Leaf), Ashwagandha Extract (Withania somnifera) (Root), Ginger (Zingiber officinale) (Root), Maca (Lepidium meyenii) (Root), Muira Puama (Ptychopetalum olacoides) (Root), L-Phenylalanine, Asparagus Extract (Asparagus officinalis) (Stem), Chinese Smilax (Smilax china) (Root).

Manufacturer's country: USA

Product amount: 60 capsules / 1.84 oz / 0.12 lb / 52 g

Gross weight (oz/lbs/g): 2.56 oz / 0.16 lbs / 73 g

Suggested use: As a dietary supplement, take two (2) capsules daily with water. For best results, light exercise and a sensible diet are recommended. Use this product for no less than 8 weeks for maximum results. Do not exceed 4 capsules daily.

Warning: Do not exceed recommended dose. Pregnant or nursing mothers, children under the age of 18, and individuals with a known medical condition should consult a physician before using this or any dietary supplement. For Adult Use Only.


*These statements have not been evaluated by the Food and Drug Administration. This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.
